findings.finding: Inspected 22 actual flat brass product families plus unrelated search results. Existing p1065462/p1065464 group supplies 100-square0.5 but 200-square only 0.8; other 0.5 results are100×50,150×100,200×100, 300×100 or rolls. No new300-square, 300×200 or200-square0.5 matching image found in this pass. No photos silently assigned to differing cuts.
Search returned already accepted300×200,200-square and100-square, other rectangle thicknesses/cuts and round plates; no exact 300 × 300 × 0.5 mm source photo found.

Harfington search returns primarily anodized coloured engraving blanks, profiles and different sizes. Cross-retailer uxcell traces resolved exact 300 × 300 × 0.5 mm single-sheet eBay native and 200 × 100 × 0.5 mm Amazon CDN source via public retailer. Yahoo supplier photos could not be decoded (no image bytes returned). No remaining aluminium cut was inferred from those two sources.

Harfington p1680316 explicitly supplies white 300 × 200 × 3 mm. Six native sources inspected: main accepted, dimension composite/repeated detail/promotional coloured or cut applications excluded. Other listed white cuts 8×8,12×6,12×12 do not match150×200. No generic coloured stock assigned.
